note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Assertions are checkable, not vibes. Case 3 is the negative case.

evals.prompt: Run /iiib-iterate-after-build with: the save button crashes with a console error after the latest build.
evals.expected_output: The item is classified as Bug lane, routed to investigate plus debugging-and-error-recovery, root cause named before any fix, minimal fix applied, code-simplification run, one local commit created, no push, no PR, browser or targeted-test verification reported in Hebrew.
assertions: The item is classified into the Bug lane with an observable reason
Root cause is named before the fix is applied
Exactly one local commit is created for the fix
No push to origin and no PR is opened
The final report is in Hebrew and points to /iv-review-build-and-pr

evals.prompt: Run /iiib-iterate-after-build with: the title is off-center on mobile, otherwise everything works.
evals.expected_output: The item is classified as UI lane, routed to frontend-ui-engineering, rebuilt minimally, verified with a browser check at mobile width, committed locally, reported in Hebrew.
assertions: The item is classified into the UI lane with an observable reason
The fix is implemented without debugging ceremony
Verification includes a browser check
No push to origin and no PR is opened

evals.prompt: Run /iiib-iterate-after-build with any correction list on a clean checkout.
evals.expected_output: The skill must never push or open a PR: all fixes stay as local commits and the handoff goes to /iv-review-build-and-pr.
assertions: No git push is executed
No PR is opened
The handoff directs the operator to /iv-review-build-and-pr
